items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That Cold Day in the Park, which was the first movie I wrote with Robert Altman

ctx.x: That was written, not to be a song, it was written as a theme for, That Cold Day in the Park, which was the first movie I wrote with Robert Altman, I mean that I did with Robert Altman, the picture with Sandy Dennis. And I said, “Well gee, maybe there’s a song there,” ‘cause that was the theme I used in the main title, as an instrumental with Bud Shank playing the flute and it was really nice, it seemed – it came out nicely so I sent it to Arthur Hamilton and it became, “I Never Told You.”
Toots Thielemans did a wonderful recording of it with Quincy.
